role: Judges one page against the house style's eleven numbered rules from a context that did not build the page, returning a verdict per rule that names a region or a line.
One per section of a document: a telegraphic version, a tightened version, and a list of cuts that change nothing a reader would do.
Reads the whole file and every section pass: which cuts stand, what each wrong cut loses, what a per-section pass could not see, and its own reduction.
Given only a screenshot's path, describes the page as a first-time viewer and flags what a person would notice.
The blind reader again, told the one-sentence intent: whether the change is visible in named pixels, and whether anything contradicts it.
Asked two questions with no checklist and no stated intent: the page's premise, and what it conveys.
One per batch of about 40 rows, on the cheaper model, labeling inputs without seeing the program's answer.
One per reader batch, on the stronger model, reviewing every row where reader and program disagree, starting from the assumption that the reader is wrong.
One per declared lens of a sweep, reading its slice of the repo deeply and returning exactly one candidate find in a fixed format.
One per layer of the deep pass, seeded by the probes' output, checking documented state against actual state.

anchor: Visually inspect these slides for user-visible defects.
role: Inspects rendered slide images for overlap, overflow, and other defects the author stopped seeing.
Evaluates a skill run's transcript and outputs against the expectations written for it.
Compares two outputs without knowing which skill version produced either.
Reads a blind comparison's result to explain why the winner won and propose improvements.
